# relyance_integration_connection (Resource)

Manages an integration connection for a vendor. The vendor's field schema (auth methods, fields) comes from the relyance_integration_vendor data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relyance_integration_vendor" "s3" {
  vendor = "aws_s3"
}

data "relyance_business_nodes" "all" {}

resource "relyance_integration_connection" "s3" {
  vendor = "aws_s3"
  name   = "Data-lake S3"

  scan_from = "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z"

  # Reference business nodes by name, not record id:
  business_node_ids = [data.relyance_business_nodes.all.by_name["Engineering"]]

  auth = {
    method = "iam-role-direct"
    params = {
      account_id = "123456789012"
      role_name  = "S3ScanRole"
      region     = "us-east-2"
    }
    # Secret fields (is_secret in the vendor data source) are write-only:
    # never stored in state. Bump secrets_wo_version to re-send after rotation.
    secrets_wo         = { external_id = var.s3_external_id }
    secrets_wo_version = 1
  }

  # Scan capabilities (see relyance_integration_vendor for available scans):
  scans = {
    data-inspection  = { enabled = true, fields = { sampling_percent = "10" } }
    assets-discovery = { enabled = true }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the connection.
- `vendor` (String) The vendor to connect, e.g. aws_s3 — see the relyance_integration_vendor data source. Changing it forces a new connection.

### Optional

- `auth` (Attributes) Credential configuration. Omit for connections whose credentials are managed outside Terraform (e.g. OAuth vendors authorized in the browser). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `business_node_ids` (Set of String) Business node ids this connection is associated with.
- `connect_on_apply` (Boolean) When true, trigger a live credential test after each apply that changes the connection. The result is asynchronous; read auth.status on a later refresh.
- `credentials_expire_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the stored credentials expire.
- `data_storage_location` (Attributes) Where the vendor stores data (Relyance Location shape). Set the parts you know; unset parts are omitted. Values are the canonical Location strings used across ROPA/DSR. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_storage_location))
- `integration_type` (String) IntegrationType enum name (e.g. INTEGRATION_TYPE_VENDOR). Server default applies when omitted. Changing it forces a new connection.
- `refresh_frequency_seconds` (Number) How often to rescan, in seconds.
- `scan_from` (String) RFC3339 timestamp; scans consider data from this point forward (e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z).
- `scans` (Attributes Map) Scan capabilities to enable on this connection, keyed by scan slug (e.g. data-inspection, assets-discovery — see the relyance_integration_vendor data source). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scans))
- `support_secret_access` (Boolean) Allow Relyance support to access stored secrets for troubleshooting.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-allocated connection id, unique within the vendor.

<a id="nestedatt--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth`

Required:

- `method` (String) Authentication method for this vendor (e.g. iam-role-direct, api-key) — see the relyance_integration_vendor data source for available methods.

Optional:

- `params` (Map of String) Non-secret auth fields (stored in state, fully diffable).
- `secrets_wo` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret auth fields. Write-only: never stored in state or plan files. Because write-only values cannot be diffed, changing a secret value alone produces NO plan change — bump secrets_wo_version to re-send rotated secrets.
- `secrets_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for secrets_wo: bump this integer whenever secret values change so Terraform re-sends them.

Read-Only:

- `credentials_fingerprint` (String) Server-side hash of the stored secrets; changes when credentials change.
- `status` (String) Live credential status (e.g. AUTH_STATUS_CONNECTED). Volatile by design.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 time of the last credential write.


<a id="nestedatt--data_storage_location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_storage_location`

Optional:

- `country` (String) Country, e.g. "United States".
- `region` (String) Region, e.g. "European Union".
- `state` (String) State or province.


<a id="nestedatt--scans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scans`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this scan is enabled.

Optional:

- `fields` (Map of String) Scan-specific configuration fields.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing connection as "<vendor>/<connection_id>":
terraform import relyance_integration_connection.s3 aws_s3/0
```
